name: TikTok Trend Intelligence API
description: Real-time TikTok trending videos, hashtag analytics, creator profiles, and sound trends — routed through real 4G/5G mobile carrier IPs that bypass TikTok's aggressive anti-bot.
longDescription: TikTok is the hardest platform to scrape. It uses encrypted headers, behavioral fingerprinting, and real-time fraud scoring. Datacenter IPs are blocked instantly. Even residential IPs get flagged at scale. This service routes through real mobile carrier IPs (T-Mobile, Vodafone, Orange) — the only reliable path for TikTok data. Extract trending For You page content, hashtag analytics with view counts, creator profiles with engagement metrics, and sound/audio trend data across 6 countries.

endpoints.description: Trending videos, hashtags, and sounds by country
Hashtag analytics — views, growth velocity, top videos
Creator profile — followers, engagement, recent posts
Sound/audio trend data — usage count, trending status

whyMobileProxy: TikTok employs the most advanced anti-scraping in social media: device fingerprinting (TLS fingerprint, canvas hash, WebGL renderer), behavioral analysis (datacenter IPs flagged within minutes), encrypted headers (X-Bogus, _signature, msToken validated against IP reputation), and geo-fencing. Mobile carrier IPs have high trust scores and pass all device trust checks that datacenter/residential IPs fail.
